visual_identity.body: Small, plump, and covered in soft 'animated' downy feathers. Two wings with visible but small, rounded vestigial claws at the 'elbow' joint.
visual_identity.coloration: Vibrant turquoise and sunny yellow feathers to provide high contrast against the formation's purple and white ground colors.
visual_identity.face: Large, sparkling black eyes with expressive white 'eyebrows' made of feathers. A short, slightly hooked beak.
visual_identity.no_text_constraint: True. Personality is shown through tilting the head and 'puffed out' chest feathers.

personality: Cheerful, jittery, and very curious. It moves with quick, hopping motions and short bursts of flight.
